title: Engineering the NAMC National Event Portal
summaryLead: The digital home for a national conference: tickets, sponsors, schedule and passes.
story: The National Association of Minority Contractors runs national gatherings that depend on a small admin team. Ticket sales, sponsorships, schedules and attendee access were spread across separate tools. They came to us for one event site that could carry the whole experience through peak registration. We built it static-first on Netlify, with serverless forms for sponsor applications, calendar sync for the agenda, a way for small businesses to find the right meetings, and a digital pass for every attendee.

features.title: Tickets and sponsorships
features.text: Tier selection and vector logo upload are validated before they reach the admin team.

features.title: Schedule with calendar sync
features.text: A scannable agenda. One tap builds an .ics file for Apple, Google or Outlook.

features.title: Meeting finder
features.text: Helps small businesses find the right meetings.

features.title: Digital pass
features.text: Every attendee gets a digital pass.

features.title: Accessible
features.text: Built to WCAG 2.1 AA targets, with keyboard and screen-reader support.
